roles.title: Project Manager
roles.company: Desert Dreams Turf Landscaping & Swimming Pool
bullets: Lead design development, technical detailing, site coordination and handover for 13+ luxury residential landscape and swimming pool projects.
Managed the One by Omniyat commercial interior fit-out, including spatial planning, detailed drawings, contractor coordination and site quality control.
Develop hardscape and softscape plans, water features, bespoke pergolas, pool details, lighting layouts and material selection boards.
Coordinate structural engineers, MEP consultants, landscape contractors and pool specialists to resolve design and on-site technical challenges.
Manage procurement, sample approvals, vendor negotiations and client sign-offs; oversee schedules, resources, budgets, site inspections and safety compliance.

roles.title: Design & Building Architect
bullets: Designed RTA portacabin bus stations, premium bus shades and shelters, including spatial planning, structural detailing and technical packages.
Developed Dubai Customs event structures and winter camp layouts, and Dubai Ambulance event and temporary-structure designs.
Managed villa design development and detailed two landscape projects responding to client requirements and local environmental conditions.
Prepared site surveys, feasibility studies, authority submission sets, fabrication details, framing plans and material specifications; coordinated stakeholders and modular assembly.
Reviewed layouts, structural feasibility and finishes; produced 3D visualisations with Enscape, Lumion and D5, collaborating with interior designers and consultants.

roles.title: Junior Architect
bullets: Prepared working drawings, plans, elevations, sections and construction documentation aligned with local building and zoning regulations.
Coordinated architectural, structural and MEP information; developed schematic concepts, spatial zoning and 3D visuals for client consultations.

roles.title: Architectural Intern
bullets: Supported schematic drawings, site plans, zoning analysis and specifications; assisted with CAD drafting, 3D modelling, visual presentations and documentation.

summary: Project Manager and Architect working across residential landscapes, commercial interiors and public infrastructure in Dubai. Experienced in concept design, technical documentation, structural and MEP coordination, authority submissions and site delivery. Combines spatial planning, material sensitivity and advanced 3D visualisation to carry projects from design development through handover.
